lastText: File ClosedDivided Ground, No Institution SparedAllied Pacific Command, Beginning 1940The most consequential double departure from the historical record produced here: a divided Japan, split like Germany, with no institution, not the throne, not the war cabinet, spared the tribunal. Whether an occupation carrying both burdens at once holds together at all is uncertain.
